claim: To enable an endpoint service to accept IPv6 requests, all Network Load Balancers for the endpoint service must use the dualstack IP address type; the targets do not need to support IPv6 traffic.

evidence.quote: To enable your endpoint service to accept IPv6 requests, its Network Load Balancers must use the dualstack IP address type. The targets do not need to support IPv6 traffic.

All Network Load Balancers for the endpoint service must use the dualstack IP address type. The targets do not need to support IPv6 traffic. If the service processes source IP addresses from the proxy protocol version 2 header, it must process IPv6 addresses.
